execution.decision: Use the fixed information curve to determine whether additional within-task observations can plausibly close the shape-learning gap. Do not relax the failed two-episode complete-model gate or promote any candidate. If extra observations help,next compare source structural/native,flat and source GP under identical observation/verification budgets before a jointly aligned KG test.
